answer: An escrow vault blocks fake identities. Each agent locks a 30-credit bond in the vault, and every invitation is drawn on a referral graph, like a karst map where each underground river is visible, so no hidden channel smuggles a fake. Any peer may dispute an identity; a proven fake loses its bond and its sponsor is slashed 30 credits too. Forging 100 identities costs 3,000 credits, while an honest agent pays once and is refunded after 10 epochs.
